title: Articles a / an / the
summary: Use a/an for singular countable nouns mentioned for the first time or as examples. Use the when the listener knows which
rule: Use a/an for singular countable nouns mentioned for the first time or as examples. Use the when the listener knows which one. No article with plural generics in general statements.
examples: The pen on the desk is blue.
tutorHints: Teach sound not spelling: a university, an hour.
